name: app-dark-ui-kit-sheet-with-pistachio-lemon-tangerine-raspberry-palette
title: Dark Watch UI Kit with Fruit Palette
whatItIs: A black UI-kit poster with pill labels at the top, a giant 'UI-KIT' title, bento tiles of a yellow petal icon on a grid, font specimens in yellow, chart widgets (a gradient bar chart, an AQI gauge, a line chart, map pins) and a 4-by-3 grid of named colour swatches (Pistachio, Lemon, Tangerine, Raspberry and their pale Air versions, Ivory, Almond, Chestnut, Espresso).
whatItMeans: Food-themed colour names and a warm palette on black make a technical kit feel appetising, and gradient gauges show the palette in use.
techniques: Named swatches with hex codes in a tidy grid
Pale and saturated pairs of each hue
Yellow accent tiles on dark neutrals
Icon shown on a construction grid

vocabulary.definition: A colour sample labelled with a memorable name and hex code.
A saturated colour paired with a paler version.
A small dark card holding one data visual.
